text:
One man designed both the Royal Oak and the Nautilus: Gérald Genta.

The Royal Oak was designed in 1970 for Audemars Piguet. Patek Philippe introduced the Nautilus in 1976, also designed by Genta. Two brands, six years apart.

The cover photo shows an Audemars Piguet Royal Oak.
